d.d: The nocturnal, insectivorous, burrowing mammal Orycteropus afer, of the order Tubulidentata and somewhat resembling a pig. Common in some parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
d.x: The aardvark burrows in the ground and feeds mostly on termites, which it catches with its long, slimy tongue.

d.d: A particular Hindu prayer ritual, involving candles made from clarified butter.
